text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Do you have some free time for a while? Would you mind looking after
one of the horsegirls on my team until the Fukushima Kinen?

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I need to focus on coaching the girls scheduled to run in Tokyo on the same day,
so accompanying her on the trip is going to be tough for me.

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
The Fukushima Kinen is a 2000m graded stakes race.
She's suffered consecutive losses at 2000m, so I want to address it early—
choice_data_list: Sure thing, leave it to me.

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text: Thanks! Sorry about this, especially when you've got scouting preparations of your own.
choice_data_list: Putting the horsegirls first is second nature!

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Haha, that's what I like about you. That's why I know I can trust you with her.
I'm counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(Providing substitute coaching—
I suppose situations like that happen between Trainers.)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Have you decided which event to enter for the upcoming track meet?
...I'm torn between the 1600m and 1800m...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
The Mile, obviously! It's our big semiannual chance to race
against upperclassmen who've already debuted! I really wanna race Taiki-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(The track meet... What should I do?
Running while still wondering if I should quit racing...)

text_block_list.name: Bobbed Chestnut Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*... My split times in the final stretch are completely hopeless, aren't they...?
To run 2000m, I need to add more endurance training.
choice_data_list: It looks fine to me, but let's add some more just in case.

text_block_list.name: Bobbed Chestnut Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Yes, please! My Trainer told me
there wasn't any issue either... but I just couldn't stop worrying about it.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(She... looks relieved. Even though she seemed so anxious just moments ago.
Is that thanks to Trainer-san's response—?)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Bouquet-chan! What's the matter?
You'll hurt yourself if you don't watch what you're doing.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Ah...—I am so sorry.
You're right... I think—I will go take a break.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
......Phew. I went and caused trouble for everyone...
I really need to focus—

text_block_list.name: Bob-Haired Chestnut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
That's six interval runs done!
Um... I know it's a bit late to ask, but do you think I'll make it in time for the real thing?
choice_data_list: You'll be fine. But what's making you feel uneasy?

text_block_list.name: Bob-Haired Chestnut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Well... stamina isn't built overnight.
Even if I start working on it now...
choice_data_list: Then let's rethink your pacing with a practice partner.

text_block_list.name: Bob-Haired Chestnut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
! Yes...! If there's anything else I can do to prepare!
I want to try it all, every single thing!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(Wow, what a transformation—having someone stay by your side through your worries like that.
It really helps you stay positive... Hehe.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
――――
...I should get back to training, too.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ――――Phew.
choice_data_list: Excuse me. Could I ask a favor?
Excuse me. Could I ask a favor?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Huh?! M-Me...?
choice_data_list: Yeah. Would you mind running alongside her as a practice partner?
Yeah. Would you mind running alongside her as a practice partner?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my very best to serve as her running partner.
Um—how should I pace myself?
choice_data_list: Could you just run as you normally do?
Could you just run as you normally do?

text_block_list.name: Bob-Haired Chestnut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
You said this was to review my pacing, right?
Bouquet-san, are you better at longer distances?
choice_data_list: Yeah. I think it'll serve as a great reference for pacing.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(—She's holding back in the rear.
Thanks to that—it's very easy to run.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —We're approaching the fourth corner. Time for the final spurt!

text_block_list.name: Bob-Haired Chestnut Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ! I see, so this is the spot! Haaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Bob-Haired Chestnut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
All right, I managed to chase all the way through to the end!
Wait, but the overall time hasn't changed much, has it?
choice_data_list: Yeah, pacing was the main issue all along.

text_block_list.name: Bob-Haired Chestnut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I had no idea. Knowing why I hit a plateau makes me feel so much better!
Bouquet-san, could we run together again sometime?!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes, with pleasure.
I... would love to run with you again too.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (The scenery flowing past. The gentle breeze caressing my cheeks—it felt so comforting.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Ah—Trainer-san. Thank you for your hard work.
choice_data_list: Good work. Thanks for helping out as a practice partner today.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Not at all. Thank you so much for inviting me.
For the first time in a long while—I felt the joy of running.
choice_data_list: Haha, running really is second nature for an Umamusume.
Hehe, running really is second nature for an Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, that's true. —To be able to help with my running—
and create "harmony"... made me very happy.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
......—
I started racing because I was captivated by the beauty of "harmony."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
However, I'm simply not cut out for conflict.
Even in races, I can never push forward—I only disrupt the harmony.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Even knowing that, I can't change it—I just keep destroying it.
Everyone's harmony. —Their brilliance.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—I should probably just quit racing.
But—... But—
choice_data_list: Take all the time you need to think it over.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Running with feelings like these—
isn't it disrespectful to everyone else...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
To everyone who burns with such fiery passion to win.
My running—can hardly be called sincere...
choice_data_list: But you're hesitating precisely because you still want to run.
But you're hesitating precisely because you still want to run.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—... Yes.
Even though I know it isn't sincere...—
choice_data_list: It's okay to cherish what your own heart wants.
It's okay to cherish what your own heart wants.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
choice_data_list: It's your racing career. Give it all the thought it deserves.
It's your racing career. Give it all the thought it deserves.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Trainer... san...—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I will think about it.
Until these doubts—fade away completely.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(—Trainer-san is always there, supporting me through everything...
Why are your words... always so remarkably warm...?)
